capabilities: Fetch all SonicNote recordings and generate one Markdown file per recording
Import AI transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps
Import AI summaries, study reports, and handwritten notes from the app
Resync automatically on startup or at set intervals
Configure frontmatter fields and custom properties for synced files
disambiguation: Not a vault-sync tool; it imports recordings from the SonicNote app into the vault as Markdown files.
extras: Manual installation only (download zip from Releases); requires Obsidian desktop v0.15.0+; synced files are not overwritten by default, so deleting the local file is needed to get updated content.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull recordings and their AI-generated transcripts and summaries from the SonicNote app into a vault.

relations.evidence: Sync recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and study reports from SonicNote to Obsidian as Markdown files.

summary: SonicNote integration that imports recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and study reports from the SonicNote app as Markdown notes.
